reconciliation_findings: M7.0 prints two identical new pump selections and labels their schedule notes N+1; this is a source classification, not an unprinted lead/lag rotation sequence.
The M6.3 typed I/O diagram binds pump-specific alarm/VFD-speed/start-stop/current callouts to PCWP-1001 and PCWP-1002, but does not state PLC card/channel/terminal numbers.
M7.0 separates existing and new PCW demand. The revised 581.998 GPM new PCW flow is not automatically a sum of installed device rows, and it is retained as a source demand total.

The diagram shows a modulating chilled-water control valve and makeup actuator, while the supplied set lacks an actual control-valve or damper-actuator schedule; unsupported Cv, fail action, torque and actuator signal must stay unknown.
